description: Bundled packages published without a licence file. Each entry names a package from the same repository, under the same licence, whose licence file supplies the text, or quotes the package's own `statement` when it is dedicated to the public domain; scripts/third-party-licenses.mjs checks that both declare `license`. A bundled package missing from this list and without a licence file fails the build.

bs58.reason: bs58 4.0.1 (nested under @solana/web3.js and borsh) has no LICENSE; the hoisted bs58 of the same cryptocoinjs/bs58 repository ships one

jsonify.statement: jsonify (https://github.com/ljharb/jsonify), by Douglas Crockford: "public domain" (README, section "license"; package.json "license": "Public Domain").
jsonify.reason: Crockford's JSON parser/stringifier, dedicated to the public domain; bundled through json-stable-stringify, a dependency of @codama/visitors-core
